CANONICAL_NAME.value: genann -- a minimal feedforward neural network in C (Lewis Van Winkle)

VERSION.value: github.com/codeplea/genann master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: The perceptron/MLP lineage (Rosenblatt 1958 -> Rumelhart backprop 1986): genann is a tiny ANSI C multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation -- the connectionist update rule and forward pass in a few hundred readable lines

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: supervised learning of nonlinear functions by a connectionist network

value.built_to: learn a nonlinear input-output mapping from examples by adjusting connection weights via gradient descent (backpropagation) through a layered network
value.pressure: a mapping (like XOR) that no single linear unit can represent; the network must distribute the function across hidden units and learn the weights from data alone
value.success_means: the trained network generalises the target function (e.g. learns XOR, classifies IRIS) from examples

value.pressure: a nonlinearly-separable task, learning from examples only (no programmed rule)
value.failure_condition: failure to converge (bad learning rate / local minimum) or overfitting -- the net memorises noise and does not generalise

ANCESTRY.value: The perceptron/MLP lineage (Rosenblatt 1958 -> Rumelhart backprop 1986): genann is a tiny ANSI C multilayer perceptron trained by backpropagation -- the connectionist update rule and forward pass in a few hundred readable lines

cut.note: backpropagation with nothing else: one weight array laid out layer by layer with a bias weight first, a forward pass that walks it once, and a training step that computes deltas backward and applies plain SGD per example -- no momentum, no batching, no regularisation

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: genann_init / the weight, output, delta arrays; the -1.0 bias term in genann_run
organs.mechanism: one malloc holds the struct, all weights (inputs+1 per hidden neuron in layer 1, hidden+1 per neuron after), all neuron outputs and all deltas; the bias is implemented as an extra weight multiplied by a constant -1.0 at the head of every neuron's dot product; every routine locates a layer by arithmetic on (inputs, hidden, hidden_layers, outputs)
organs.output: an allocated network with random weights in [-0.5, 0.5)
assumptions: all hidden layers have the same width; a fully connected topology; doubles
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: cache-friendly, copyable with memcpy (genann_copy), serialisable as a list of numbers
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the size checks refuse absurd dimensions; no other guard

organs.human_name: genann_run; genann_act_sigmoid / _cached (4096-entry lookup) / linear / threshold / tanh / relu
organs.mechanism: copy the inputs into the output array; for each neuron of each layer compute bias plus the dot product with the previous layer's outputs, apply the layer's activation function pointer, store; the default sigmoid is a 4096-entry table over [-15, 15] built once (with clamping outside), so the forward pass avoids exp()
organs.output: the output layer's values (a pointer into the network's own buffer)
assumptions: the lookup's quantisation (30/4096 per step) is below the training noise; assert(!isnan) is the only numerical check
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a forward pass with no allocation and no transcendental calls
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the cached sigmoid is not smooth, so its derivative used in training is the analytic y(1-y) of the QUANTISED output, a small mismatch

organs.mechanism: run forward; output deltas = (target - output) x f'(output) (or just the difference for a linear output); hidden deltas layer by layer backward = f'(output) x sum over the next layer of (its delta x the weight from this neuron), with the weight index computed from the layout; then every weight += learning_rate x delta x input-to-that-weight, bias weight with input -1; the derivative is computed from the stored activation value (y(1-y), 1-y^2, step for relu), so the forward outputs must still be in the buffer
organs.input: one (input, target) pair; a learning rate
assumptions: squared error (the delta form assumes it); one example at a time; the caller loops over epochs and shuffles if it wants
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the whole learning rule in ~90 lines; every index is derived from the layout, no matrices
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: no gradient clipping; a large learning rate diverges; relu with the threshold derivative can die (zero gradient) and nothing revives it
organs.human_prior: Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams 1986 backpropagation in its most literal form; the author's stated goal is minimalism

rejected_cuts.candidate: genann_read / genann_write (text serialisation), genann_free, the examples and the minctest harness
rejected_cuts.note: test.c is a ready oracle (XOR etc.) for a Stage C run on a host with a C compiler

rejected_cuts.evidence: layout, forward pass and learning rule are separately replaceable; the vault's hopfield and minisom bodies share the first two and not the third

pressures.source_evidence: genann.c genann_train; record tags backpropagation / learning
pressures.condition: an organism holds parameters; the world shows one (input, target) at a time and scores the output; the organism may change each parameter only by a quantity computed from signals available at that parameter
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one pass per example; parameters fixed in number
pressures.failure_condition: error does not fall, or falls then diverges
pressures.world_punishes: global updates (not local) and updates that need the whole dataset
pressures.world_rewards: a chain rule that delivers a local error to every parameter
pressures.observable_consequence: training error vs examples seen on XOR and on a noisy regression, across learning rates
pressures.vacuity_condition: a linearly separable target (a perceptron suffices) or a lookup-table-sized world
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: memorising examples; a world that reveals the target function
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the target function's parameters must show zero error immediately; the ancestor at a learning rate 100x too high must diverge: the world must show both
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: minimal feed-forward neural network training (Van Winkle, genann)
